answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 4488 Country: India Title: Theres a firm which do halal business (construction and many others) as i have invested money in that firm and monthly they pay fix amount to me depending on how much investment made. Question: Theres a firm which do halal business (construction and many others) as i have invested money in that firm and monthly they pay fix amount to me depending on how much investment made. Answer ID: 4488 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1315/1004=H/1429) Fixed amount is interest which is haram . If you and the firm have agreed upon some amount of profit, then you should write it clearly. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
